ValidationRule.description: SS-12270: Validation to ensure that if "Exposure Management for Operational Tech” is selected, then “Core for Operational Technology” must also be selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( Exposure_Management_for_Operational_Tech__c = True, Core_for_Operational_Technology__c = False, Today() <= End_Date__c , NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
/* 04-15-26 SS-13060: Removed Start_Date from the criteria */
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Exposure Management for Operational Tech is selected, then Core for Operational Technology must also be selected.
